Our first catch of the day.|Lieutenant Cabbel and Captain Lennox, aboard the ''Tyrant''|audio=Cabbel-Lennox.flac|}} The '''''Tyrant''''' was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Imperial Navy]]. Under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Captain]] [[Lennox]], it served as part of [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] personal [[fleet]], [[Death Squadron]]. In [[3 ABY]], along with the rest of the fleet, it took part in the [[Battle of Hoth]], where the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] assaulted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] secret [[Echo Base|base]] on the [[Water|ice]] [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. The rebels had installed a powerful [[deflector shield]] to protect their base, so the five [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyers]] of Death Squadron, including the ''Tyrant'', [[blockade]]d the planet to stop [[Alliance Military|Alliance forces]] from escaping the Imperial [[Blizzard Force|ground assault]]. As such, the ''Tyrant'' tried to intercept the [[Quantum Storm|first]] rebel [[GR-75 medium transport|transport]] attempting to flee Hoth; however, the [[Star Destroyer]] was disabled by the rebels' [[V-150 Planet Defender|v-150 ion cannon]] and left to drift into deep [[Realspace|space]] while the rebel [[Starship|ship]] escaped. ==Description== An [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]], the 1,600-[[meter]]-long ''Tyrant''{{SWCT|set=Base Series 1|cardname=Toryn Farr - Communications Officer}} was armed with eight [[octuple turbolaser barbette]]s (four port, four starboard), ten heavy [[Tractor beam projector|tractor beam emitters]], and [[missile launcher]]s. It was additionally equipped with a [[conning tower]], a [[communications tower]], a [[solar ionization reactor]], two [[deflector shield generator dome]]s, and a [[hangar]] bay. The ''Tyrant'' was propelled by three [[Destroyer-I ion engine]]s, four emergency-use [[Gemon-4 ion engine]]s, and a [[hyperdrive]]. ==History== ===Serving Death Squadron=== {{Quote|Make ready to land our troops beyond their energy field and deploy the fleet so that nothing gets off the system.|Darth Vader|audio=VaderPiett-Hoth.flac|}} [[File:Death-Squadron-ISDs.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Tyrant'', with four other ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers of Death Squadron]] In [[3 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], which includes the ''Tyrant''{{'s}} appearance, to [[3 ABY]]. during the [[Galactic Civil War]], the ''Tyrant'' was part of the [[Imperial Navy]] and [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by [[Captain]] [[Lennox]].{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Force Attax The Force Awakens|cardname=Captain Lennox|link=https://www.tradingcarddb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/122192/cid/8287767/2016-Topps-Star-Wars-Force-Attax-The-Force-Awakens-39-Captain-Lennox}} It was one of the five main [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] in [[Death Squadron]], a mobile [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[fleet]] commanded by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] from his [[flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Executor]]''.''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' At that [[time]], Death Squadron was searching for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] secret [[Echo Base|base]], as part of an Imperial operation known as [[Project Swarm]].[[Doctor Aphra (2016) 37|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 37]] When a [[XJ9-CS14|probe droid]] discovered the rebel base on the [[Water|ice]] [[planet]] [[Hoth]], Vader and the fleet's [[admiral]], [[Kendal Ozzel]], led Death Squadron, including the ''Tyrant'', to the [[Hoth system]] to wipe out the Rebellion. However, Ozzel had his [[Starship|ships]] drop out of [[hyperspace]] too close to the [[Star system|system]], alerting the rebels to the Imperial presence and allowing them to deploy a powerful [[deflector shield]] over their base, protecting it from [[orbital bombardment]]. ===Battle of Hoth=== {{Quote|The Empire has moved a destroyer directly into the path of the transports.|General Rieekan, concerning the ''Tyrant''|audio=Rieekan-transports.flac|''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]''}} [[File:TyrantDamaged-ESB.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Tyrant'' was disabled by Echo Base's ion cannon.]] Due to the rebels' shield, Death Squadron was forced to deploy a [[Blizzard Force|ground assault]], with its [[capital ship]]s, such as the ''Tyrant'', forming a [[blockade]] to prevent the rebels from escaping. However, the Alliance nonetheless began its evacuation, starting with the [[GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Quantum Storm]]'', escorted by two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter]]s. The ''Tyrant'' moved into the path of the [[transport]]s, and [[Lieutenant]] [[Cabbel]],{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Force Attax The Force Awakens|cardname=Lieutenant Cabbel|link=https://www.tradingcarddb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/122192/cid/8287769/2016-Topps-Star-Wars-Force-Attax-The-Force-Awakens-41-Lieutenant-Cabbel}} a [[controller]] on the Star Destroyer's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], alerted Lennox of the situation while the captain observed Hoth through the bridge's [[viewport]]s. Lennox consequently expressed his pleasure at the opportunity to capture the first rebel ships of the [[Standard day|day]]. The ''Tyrant''{{'s}} shields were then lowered and its [[tractor beam]] readied. However, just as the tractor beam had locked onto the enemy transport, the rebels' [[v-150 Planet Defender]] [[ion cannon]] on Hoth, which was commanded by the base's chief [[communications officer]], [[Toryn Farr]], fired several shots at the unshielded ''Tyrant''. The Empire had not known the rebels possessed such heavy ordinance, and so the blockade was unprepared for such an assault. In the attack, the ''Tyrant''{{'s}} shipboard electronics were scrambled, its [[missile]] launchers and conning tower were destroyed, and several explosions spread across its [[hull]] causing the ship to go dark.{{StoryCite|story=Ion Control|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}} [[File:TyrantDisabled-BTCTG.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Quantum Storm'' and its escort fighters escaped past the damaged ''Tyrant''.]] The ion shots caused the ''Tyrant'' to veer, then spin out of control, careering into deep [[Realspace|space]]. This allowed the first rebel evacuation group to escape the system through hyperspace. Although the Empire ultimately claimed victory in the [[Battle of Hoth]], destroying the rebels' base as intended, much of the [[Alliance Military|Alliance forces]] escaped through Death Squadron's blockade to a [[Backup Rendezvous Point Gamma-Nine|rendezvous point]]. Death Squadron then chased the rebel [[freighter]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', which was carrying the important Alliance leader [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. While the ISD ''[[Avenger]]'' and its [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] chased the ''Falcon'', the ''Tyrant'' and the ''[[Stalker]]'' closed in from the opposite direction. Taking notice of the incoming Star Destroyers, rebel [[pilot]] and [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] maneuvered the ''Falcon'' so that the ''Tyrant'' and ''Stalker'' had a near collision with the ''Avenger''.''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'' [[File:Avenger-Stalker-Tyrant.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Stalker'' and ''Tyrant'' nearly collided with the ''Avenger'' as they chased the ''Falcon''.]] The ''Falcon'' was eventually chased into the [[Hoth asteroid field|Hoth asteroid belt]] by Death Squadron, during which all vessels sustained damage, and after some [[time]], the ''Falcon'' managed to escape to the nearby planet [[Bespin]]. The squadron dispersed in search for the ship, and [[bounty hunter]]s were hired to locate it. Lennox avoided summary execution after the battle, but later [[Death|perished]] during the [[Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the [[Battle of Endor]] to [[4 ABY]]. where an Imperial fleet unsuccessfully attempted to defend the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] from rebel attack. ==Commanders and crew== The ''Tyrant'' was under the command of Captain Lennox during the Battle of Hoth. Lennox was pleased at the prospect of capturing the first rebel ships of the battle. Under Lennox was Lieutenant Cabbel, who served as a controller on the ''Tyrant''{{'s}} bridge. Other [[technician]]s were also present on the ship's bridge during the Battle of Hoth. ==Behind the scenes== ===Notable appearances=== The ''Tyrant'' first appeared in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. The Star Destroyer was not identified in the film but received the name ''Tyrant'' as part of the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Wikipedia:Mobile app|application]] [[Star Wars: Card Trader|''Star Wars'': Card Trader]], originally released in [[2015]]. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the ''Tyrant'' first appeared in the [[April]] 1980 [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]] by [[Donald F. Glut]],[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]] and its name was introduced in the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game's]] ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion, released in [[1996]].{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=''Tyrant''}} ===Model inconsistencies=== [[File:Tyrant-comparison.png|thumb|right|250px|A comparison of the different models used to depict the ''Tyrant'' in ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] The model used to depict the ''Tyrant'' in ''The Empire Strikes Back'' is not consistent between shots. In the Star Destroyer's establishing shot, it has three small flaps lining the edge of each primary engine, whereas a later shot depicts it with engines lacking these flaps. The model first used to depict the ''Tyrant'', the one with engine flaps, correlates with the ninety-one-centimeter-long Star Destroyer model used in ''The Empire Strikes Back'', which was repurposed from its original use in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. Conversely, later appearances of the ship in the film correlate to the more detailed, 259-centimeter-long Star Destroyer model built specifically for ''The Empire Strikes Back''.''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]'' ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of the Tyrant}} *''[[Star Wars: The Original Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *{{Film|V}} {{1st}} *''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]'' {{Ab|The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?
